title: 7 Day Luxury Kenya Fly-in Safari
rank_math_title: Luxury Kenya Fly-in Safari: 7 Stunning Days in Three Parks
rank_math_desc: Luxury Kenya fly-in safari for 7 days: Samburu, the Masai Mara and Amboseli, with boutique camps and light-aircraft flights between them. Price on request.
post_content: This luxury Kenya fly-in safari links three parks by air and pairs each with an exceptional boutique lodge.
overview:
This luxury Kenya fly-in safari is for travellers who want the best of Kenya in comfort. You fly between Samburu, the Masai Mara and Amboseli, and stay at small, beautifully designed lodges with excellent guiding.

Expect private game drives, fine food, spacious rooms with views and time to relax between activities.

Why choose this luxury Kenya fly-in safari?

  • Boutique lodges: small camps with only a handful of rooms.
  • Three parks: the dry north, the Mara plains and Kilimanjaro's elephants.
  • Private guiding: your own vehicle and guide on request.
  • Seamless travel: every flight and transfer arranged for you.

Where you stay

Sasaab in Samburu, Angama Mara above the Mara Triangle and Tortilis Camp in Amboseli, or similar luxury lodges.

Best time for a luxury Kenya fly-in safari

June to October is dry and excellent for wildlife, with the migration in the Mara from July. January to March is also very good and quieter.

See our Kenya safaris and all flight packages, or add a beach stay after the safari. For travel information, visit Magical Kenya.

How much does the luxury Kenya fly-in safari cost?

Price on request. The cost depends on your travel dates, group size, the season and the lodges you choose, so we prepare every quote personally rather than showing one fixed price.

faq.q: Which lodges are used on the luxury Kenya fly-in safari?
faq.a: Sasaab in Samburu, Angama Mara in the Masai Mara and Tortilis Camp in Amboseli, or similar luxury lodges.

faq.q: How much luggage can I bring?
faq.a: Light aircraft usually allow 15 kg per person, including hand luggage, in soft bags without wheels. Ask us if you need extra space.

faq.q: Where do the flights leave from in Nairobi?
faq.a: From Wilson Airport, not Jomo Kenyatta International Airport. We arrange the transfer from your hotel or from JKIA.
Most luxury lodges include house drinks. Premium wines and spirits are usually extra.

faq.q: Can I have a private vehicle?
faq.a: Yes. Private vehicles and guides can be arranged at each lodge.

faq.q: Can I end on the beach?
faq.a: Yes. You can fly from Amboseli or Nairobi to Diani, Lamu or Zanzibar.
Yes. We recommend Flying Doctors evacuation cover for every safari and can arrange it for you.

itinerary.label: Day 1
itinerary.title: Fly from Nairobi to Samburu
itinerary.content: Morning flight from Wilson Airport to Samburu. Afternoon game drive. Overnight at Sasaab.

itinerary.label: Day 2
itinerary.title: Samburu
itinerary.content: Game drives, a guided walk and time to relax by the pool overlooking the river.

itinerary.label: Day 3
itinerary.title: Fly from Samburu to the Masai Mara
itinerary.content: Fly to the Mara Triangle via Nairobi. Afternoon game drive. Overnight at Angama Mara.

itinerary.label: Day 4
itinerary.title: Masai Mara
itinerary.content: A full day of private game drives with a bush lunch. Optional balloon flight.

itinerary.label: Day 5
itinerary.title: Fly from the Masai Mara to Amboseli
itinerary.content: Morning game drive, then fly to Amboseli via Nairobi. Overnight at Tortilis Camp.

itinerary.label: Day 6
itinerary.title: Amboseli
itinerary.content: Sunrise drive for Kilimanjaro views and elephants, with a sundowner in the evening.

itinerary.label: Day 7
itinerary.title: Fly back to Nairobi
itinerary.content: Early game drive, then fly to Wilson Airport for your onward journey.
